name: Veripoint Workspace API
description: Use a Veripoint workspace key to research companies, retrieve saved reports and inspect allowance. Research uses the same allowance as the website and MCP. Free allowance resets daily at 00:00 UTC; paid allowance resets monthly. Read-only keys cannot run research. Requests are limited to 60 per minute per key. This specification covers the implemented Veripoint workspace routes; separately licensed data APIs have their own contract and credentials.
